crossRefs.note: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity; for it is the time of…
“My people, go away from the middle of her, and each of you save yourselves from Yahweh’s fierce anger.
“Set up road signs. Make guideposts. Set your heart toward the highway, even the way by which you went. Turn again…
Those who escape the sword will return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah few in number. All the remnant…
“Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.
Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With a voice of singing announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth…
Those ransomed by Yahweh will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will…
Shake yourself from the dust! Arise, sit up, Jerusalem! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck, captive daughter…
Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry…
For you shall not go out in haste, neither shall you go by flight: for Yahweh will go before you; and the God of Israel…
‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’
I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and…
You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you shall find him when you search after him with all your heart and…
It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and…
Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in…
Hanani, one of my brothers, came, he and certain men out of Judah; and I asked them about the Jews who had escaped, who…
I said to the king, “Let the king live forever! Why shouldn’t my face be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’…
You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which Yahweh’s word…
I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.
Lord, according to all your righteousness, let your anger and please let your wrath be turned away from your city…
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: You who have escaped the sword, go! Don’t stand still! Remember Yahweh from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.”
translations.bsb: You who have escaped the sword, depart and do not linger! Remember the LORD from far away, and let Jerusalem come to mind.”
translations.kjv: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
translations.asv: Ye that have escaped the sword, go ye, stand not still; remember Jehovah from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
